note: Both sets capture the same core claims faithfully: negative damping from the generator-torque controller in Region 3, the derivative/proportional/integral term effects under positive control gains, the second-order response, and the Ref. [10] design recommendations (neglect derivative gain, ignore generator negative damping, ωφn = 0.6 rad/s, ζφ = 0.6–0.7). Set A, however, contains an exact duplicate claim (rotor-speed error / second-order system listed twice) and a near-duplicate of the generator-torque negative-damping claim, making it more redundant and trivial. Set B covers the same content with one fewer redundant claim, so it is slightly cleaner and better. Both equally omit the blade-pitch sensitivity facts (∂P/∂θ negative in Region 3; depends on wind speed, rotor speed and blade-pitch angle) and the statement that the negative damping must be compensated by the proportional term.
